$schema: E2E harness manifest — repo-study Phase 3, item 27. The harness is the critical-path check for the web wallet: it runs the built app in Chromium and its verdict is machine-enforced (CI fails unless every case passes). This file is the contract the specs implement; a spec that contradicts it is wrong, not the manifest.

browserCheckProcedure.reconThenAction: before acting on a page, the spec reads the page first (waits for the expected heading / state) and only then interacts; a spec never clicks a selector it has not seen rendered
browserCheckProcedure.stableSelectors: prefer role/text selectors (getByRole, getByText) over CSS classes; the app has no data-testid attributes, so specs must not invent them

asserts: all four chain addresses are shown
phrase is cleared from the screen after creation
cases.covers: vault password step, phrase generation and write-down, confirm-words step, wallet-ready screen with all four chain addresses
cases.title: Create a wallet end to end

asserts: vault is open after creation (balances load)
Security screen states 'Auto-lock is off. Your wallet stays unlocked on this device.' with no duration select, no 'Lock vault' button and no unlock heading
a full reload re-opens the vault via auto-unlock with no password prompt
/lock shows no unlock screen while the vault is unlocked
cases.covers: auto-lock-off guard: vault stays open after creation, Security screen states auto-lock is off, full reload auto-unlocks, /lock shows no unlock screen while unlocked
cases.title: Vault stays unlocked (no lock screen)

asserts: each of the 20 tokens (13 natives + 7 default tokens) shows zero balance or an honest unavailable state with a reason
no invented balance or price is ever shown
cases.covers: dashboard refresh after unlock, per-token balance states (token discovery: 20-token default list)
cases.title: Dashboard balances load honestly

asserts: send flow states broadcast is disabled
no transaction is signed, built, or broadcast
cases.covers: opening the send flow shows broadcast disabled
cases.title: Send is disabled, not attempted

asserts: a blocked refresh shows a failure state with a reason
the previous balances are marked stale, not presented as current
cases.covers: refresh with the network blocked, sanitised failure state, Retry button
cases.requires: item 28 (refresh failure state) — this case is skipped until wallet-refresh.ts lands; the skip is recorded in the case file with the reason
cases.title: A failed refresh is visible, not silent

asserts: adding SHIB by its real Ethereum contract adds the token with a real (zero) balance from a live eth_call
a bad contract is rejected with a specific inline error and nothing is added
adding a chain re-enables a disabled chain and its row returns
cases.covers: Add Token dialog (add token by contract, bad input, add chain), live ERC-20 verification, /networks enable/disable
cases.title: Add Token flow works end to end

harness.command: npm run build:e2e, then npm run test:e2e (apps/web)
harness.server: vite preview of dist/ on http://127.0.0.1:4193 — started by the config's webServer block (preview:e2e), never by hand. The dist/ must be the root-base build (npm run build:e2e): the Pages build (base '/bawa/') 404s the spec routes and the suite fails at boot (ADR-0011). On a shared machine set E2E_PORT to a free port, or the tests silently attach to whatever already holds 4193.
harness.verdict: exit 0 only when every case passes; any failure fails the CI e2e job

securityBoundaries.disposableWalletsOnly: every wallet is created by the app under test during the run, with a fresh disposable vault password; never a production or existing phrase, never funded, never a real-funds key
securityBoundaries.failureScreenshotsMaskSecrets: the config sets screenshot 'off' because Playwright cannot mask regions in automatic failure shots, and a shot of the create flow would capture the recovery phrase. Instead every spec registers the shared afterEach helper from e2e/helpers.ts, which on failure takes a screenshot masked over every secret-bearing region: the phrase word grid (the section headed 'Write down your recovery phrase'), the confirm-words inputs, and every input[type=password]. If a secret-bearing region cannot be located precisely, the helper masks the whole main element — a useless screenshot beats a leaked phrase
securityBoundaries.noNetworkSecrets: specs never read or print the mnemonic, the password, or any derived key; assertions are on visible state (screen headings, button states, address presence) only
securityBoundaries.noTracing: trace is 'off' in the config and no spec may enable it — a trace would record the recovery phrase and vault password as typed
securityBoundaries.noVideo: video is 'off' for the same reason
